import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text
from shapely.geometry import Point
from shapely.wkt import loads

# Query the coordinates of Mong Kok station
query_station = text("""
SELECT coordinate
FROM air_quality_station
WHERE id = 14
""")
station_result = pd.read_sql(query_station, engine)
station_point = loads(station_result['coordinate'][0])

# Query the centroids and names of all DECLARED_MONUMENT sensitive areas
query_monuments = text("""
SELECT name, ST_Centroid(geometry) as centroid
FROM sensitive_area
WHERE category = 'DECLARED_MONUMENT'
""")
monuments_result = pd.read_sql(query_monuments, engine)

# Calculate the distance from each monument centroid to the station
monuments_result['centroid'] = monuments_result['centroid'].apply(loads)
monuments_result['distance'] = monuments_result['centroid'].apply(lambda x: station_point.distance(x) * 1000)

# Find the nearest monument
nearest_monument = monuments_result.loc[monuments_result['distance'].idxmin()]
nearest_monument_name = nearest_monument['name']
nearest_monument_distance = nearest_monument['distance']

nearest_monument_name, nearest_monument_distance
